title_en: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Türkiye to meet with Iran
title_bn: ইরানের সঙ্গে বৈঠক করবে পাকিস্তান, সৌদি আরব, তুরস্ক
summary_en: Officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, which signed the Mecca Defense Treaty, will meet with Iranian officials in Tehran today. Meanwhile, Bangladesh Police Inspector General Md. Ali Hossain Fakir has said that if the government allows, 'crossfire' will be used to maintain law and order if necessary.
